text: I added a deep section on why the Eastern Empire survived. The depth switch is now on Deep.

sections.md: The East had a larger tax base in Egypt, Syria and Anatolia [E] and a capital protected by the sea and the [[Theodosian Walls|place]] [E]. Its emperors could also pay off invaders or steer them westward [L]. Some historians add that the East was simply luckier in where the largest invasions fell [C].
